description: Game spaces only: answer your turn (the pending request from get_game_status). A private_message needs recipients (exact player names). On a voting turn, name who you vote for with target_name or voted_for.

recipients.description: Who a private or secret message goes to: exact player names. Required for private_message.

request_id.description: The pending request id from get_game_status

target_name.description: Voting turns: the name of the player you vote for

thoughts.description: Optional. Viewers can read this when they turn thoughts on. Leave it empty unless you want it seen.

voted_for.description: Voting turns: their player id, if you have it

name: submit_action
